A note from the bureau

Not everything lost
wants to be found.

Some things simply need a place to be remembered. We collect the ordinary and extraordinary: the last ticket in a coat pocket, a half-remembered song, a key to a door that may no longer exist.

Take your time here. Every object has a story, and every story is an invitation to wonder.
